fatebound.name: Fated Strike
fatebound.description: Choose one melee basic or military weapon when you take this aspect. It becomes your divine weapon. Gain training in use of this weapon if you do not already have it. When you make an attack using your divine weapon, add your Fate score to damage dealt (in addition to Power or Finesse). You may switch your Divine Weapon during any long rest. A weapon that loses its divinity turns to dust.

fatebound.name: Vaulter
fatebound.description: Once per turn as a reaction to a creature ending a move action within 5ft of you, you may move 10 feet in any direction. If you have Steadied, you may move 20 feet.

fatebound.name: Surrounded by Me
fatebound.description: Once per turn as a Boost to a or melee attack action, increase damage on that attack by half your Proficiency (rounded up) for each enemy within 5ft of you if it successfully hits. Treat Swarm enemies as a single entity for this effect.

fatebound.name: Surrounded by Friends
fatebound.description: Count all creatures (not just enemies) when determining the modifier to apply to damage by the Surrounded by Me boost.

fatebound.name: Treacherous Throw
fatebound.description: Up to once per turn while wielding two versatile weapons, choose a point within 30ft of you. Every creature within 5Xft from that spot (where X is half your Proficiency, rounded up) makes a Finesse Check against your Check DC or takes 1D4 Fumble. Roll each Fumble separately. When you use this ability, remove one versatile weapon from your inventory until the end of combat.

fatebound.name: Slickthrow
fatebound.description: When you use Treacherous Throw, increase the base dice type of Fumble given by one type.

fatebound.name: Step and Stop
fatebound.description: When you deal damage on your turn to at least 3 unique enemies, recover limb exhaustion on one if it is exhausted.

fatebound.name: Bloodletter
fatebound.description: When you attempt to give Hemorrhage to a target, they make Trait Checks against the effect at 1X disadvantage for every 3 levels of Hemorrhage you attempt to give them. Aoean

fatebound.name: Wild Strike
fatebound.description: When you hold a versatile weapon in each hand, you may make a melee attack with each weapon using a single AP. Each attack must be made against a different target. This action exhausts .

fatebound.name: Wild Cleave
fatebound.description: Whenever you kill an enemy with a melee weapon, if there is another enemy target who is both within your melee weapon range and within 5ft of that target, you may deal the remainder of your damage to that new target, provided your attack would hit the second target.

fatebound.name: Wild Chain
fatebound.description: Whenever you critically hit when you use Wild Strike, you may have the critical effect be for you to make a attack against an additional target. Treat this as part of the same attack. There is no limit to the number of times you can do this if you continue to critically hit.

fatebound.name: Wild Throws
fatebound.description: When you use Wild Strike with Versatile Weapons, you may make Versatile throws with one or either weapon.

fatebound.name: Third Arm
fatebound.description: When you use Wild Strike, you may make up to three attacks using Wild Strike using a single AP. All of these attacks must be made against different targets. [3] Parrying FocusF,R: As long as you maintain Focus, any time a creature successfully hits you with a melee attack, you may expend a reaction to make them take damage equal to your Finesse.

fatebound.name: Blade Aura
fatebound.description: In an aura 5ft around you, any creature who enters this space or starts their turn in it makes a Finesse Check or takes 1D6 points of slashing damage. Damage dealt this way increases to 1D8 at level 5, and 1D10 at level 11. Once a creature takes this damage, they cannot take it again until the start of their next turn.

fatebound.name: Stabby Aura
fatebound.description: Increase the damage dice dealt by Blade Aura by one type.

fatebound.name: Blindstab
fatebound.description: Increase the damage dice dealt by Blade Aura by one type.

fatebound.name: Bladius
fatebound.description: Increase the radius of Blade Aura from 5ft to 10ft.

fatebound.name: Greatius Bladius
fatebound.description: Increase the radius of Blade Aura from 10ft to 15ft. The Fatebound A cool mist hovers over a lake. A lost child, called to this place, peers at their still reflection. They do not see themselves, but a kingly presence – a divine god – smirking back at them. The god beckons for them to reach into the lake, and in so doing the child pulls a spear from the water, longer than they are tall, glittering in gold. It radiates power, and they immediately know that they are the son of a god. The Fatebound are the children of gods or else simple folk tricked by Fae into pacts. Wielding a divine weapon granted by their patron, they are tested by fate–and twist it to their will. The blessed Achilles, Kaguya-Hime, the Pandova brothers, and Cu Chulainn are all Fatebound, as is Thor under tribulation. All of these characters share the blessing and curse of fate, and wield holy weapons or powers which grant them power–and pose danger to themselves. Armor MasteryP: You may gain the benefit of one extra visible item while wearing armor that would obscure it (to a max of 3). Critical MasteryP: Once per Quick Rest when you roll a natural 1 on a D20 die, you may treat it as a natural 20. [Level 15] DemigodP: Increase your Power or Fate (choose one) by one additional point, to a maximum of 7.

fatebound.name: Cascading Cleave
fatebound.description: Whenever you cleave through an enemy with Slicemaster, add 1D10 damage to the next target. Increase damage dealt this way to 2D6 at level 11. [3] Hack ‘n’ SlashA: (Prerequisite: Slicemaster, Power 5). Up to once per turn, expend a number of AP up to half your Proficiency (rounded up) in a consistent attack against a single target using a slashing divine weapon. Instead of gaining advantage on to-hit, increase the damage dice by 1 dice type for each AP expended this way if you hit.

fatebound.name: Bludgeonmaster
fatebound.description: Once per quick rest when wielding a bludgeoning divine weapon, you may slam it into the ground. All enemies within 5ft of you make a Finesse Check or are knocked prone. [2] CrunchP : (Prerequisite: Bludgeonmaster). If you critically hit with a bludgeoning divine weapon and choose to rend, rend an extra 1 point of armor.

fatebound.name: Concussive Slam
fatebound.description: As a Boost to Bludgeonmaster, rend one armor on all targets who fail the Bludgeonmaster Check DC.

fatebound.name: Slamstrike
fatebound.description: When you make a melee attack using your bludgeoning divine weapon against a creature who is Prone, increase the base damage dice of that weapon by one die type.

fatebound.name: Piercemaster
fatebound.description: Once per turn when wielding a piercing divine weapon, you may throw it at a target and then summon it to your hands. Make a melee attack against a single target within 30ft of you.

fatebound.name: Nicking Touch
fatebound.description: If you critically hit with a melee attack using a piercing divine weapon and choose to maximize damage dealt, treat the damage dice of your weapon as one dice type higher for the purposes of maximizing that damage.

fatebound.name: Elegant Polearm
fatebound.description: As a Boost to Wild Strike, you may use Wild Strike at 10ft range when wielding a 10ft-range piercing divine weapon.

fatebound.name: Piercing Pin
fatebound.description: When you use Piercemaster, you may throw your weapon through one target and into another before summoning it back to you. Make a melee attack roll against two creatures in a line. Both creatures must be within 30ft of you. If the attack would hit both creatures, deal your full damage to the first target in the line, and deal half that damage to the second target (rounded up). If the attack would only hit one target, deal full damage to that target. Heavy Hitter

fatebound.name: Heavy Weaponry
fatebound.description: You gain training in heavy weapons such as greatswords, and may make a Heavy Weapon your Divine Weapon.

fatebound.name: Humongous
fatebound.description: Increase the base damage of your divine weapon by one dice type provided your divine weapon is a heavy weapon. Other creatures of your size or smaller cannot pick up or wield your divine weapon due to its immense size.

fatebound.name: Ridiculous Size
fatebound.description: Increase the base damage die of your heavy Divine Weapon by one additional dice type.

fatebound.name: Goliath Punch
fatebound.description: Whenever you critically hit while wielding an extra heavy weapon, you may choose to have the critical effect be to throw the enemy up to 5X feet away, where X is half your Proficiency (rounded up).

fatebound.name: Grandstrike
fatebound.description: When you use Wild Strike and hit at least three targets, increase the damage dealt to each target by half your Proficiency (rounded up).

fatebound.name: Wilder Strike
fatebound.description: The minimum base damage dice of Wild Strike is 1D4.

fatebound.name: Feralwild
fatebound.description: The minimum base damage dice of Wild Strike is 1D6.

fatebound.name: Slicemaster
fatebound.description: When you wield a slashing divine weapon and a hit with a melee attack reduces a target to 0HP, your weapon cleaves. Choose another target in range of your divine weapon. The remainder of your damage is dealt to them if the original to-hit roll would hit this new target. Continue cleaving until your remaining damage reaches zero.

fatebound.name: Fumbling Slice
fatebound.description: When you critically hit a target, give them 1D4 Fumble in addition to other critical effects.

fatebound.name: Critical Strike
fatebound.description: If you critically hit with your divine weapon, you may make a critical effect be that you make your next attack with an additional 1X advantage.

fatebound.name: Critical Harm
fatebound.description: If you critically hit with your divine weapon, you may make a critical effect be that you roll twice as many damage dice.

fatebound.name: Critical Conditions
fatebound.description: If you critically hit with your divine weapon, you may make a critical effect be to increase an adversarial condition of the following types: Delirium, Nausea, Hemorrhage, or Frenzy the target already possesses by one (to a maximum of your Proficiency).

fatebound.name: Critical Recovery
fatebound.description: If you critically hit with your divine weapon, you may make a critical effect be that you gain 1D6 temporary HP. Increase HP gained this way to 1D8 at level 5 and 1D10 at level 11.

fatebound.name: Fumbling Wander
fatebound.description: As a reaction to an enemy moving to within 5ft range of you, you may attempt to give them 1D8 Fumble. They make a Fate Check against this effect. If you are Steadied, you may give them 8 Fumble if they fail the check.

fatebound.name: Cunning of Crows
fatebound.description: When you use the Dodge action, you may add half your Fate Score (rounded up) to your Dodge roll.

fatebound.name: Criticality
fatebound.description: Your attacks critically hit whenever you roll a natural 19 or 20, rather than only a 20.

fatebound.name: Divine Criticality
fatebound.description: Your attacks critically hit whenever you roll a natural 18, 19, or 20.

fatebound.name: Flourishing Touch
fatebound.description: You dismiss and summon your divine weapon with a flourishing touch. Attempt to give a target Surprise (Wiles Check negates). Once you have used this on a target, you cannot use it again on targets that were within visible range of you when you used it until a quick rest has passed.

fatebound.name: Critical Tales
fatebound.description: When you use a lore point on Rousing Success to critically succeed at a to-hit action, you may apply one additional critical effect to that attack. Fated

fatebound.name: Lucky Break
fatebound.description: As an action you can harm the fate of enemies around you. Attempt to give 1D6 Fumble to a number of enemies within 10ft of you equal to your Proficiency. They make Fate Checks against this effect. You may use this once per turn.

fatebound.name: Sapped Fates
fatebound.description: Once per turn as a Boost to Lucky Break, you may gain +1 to your next to-hit roll made this turn for each enemy to which you give Fumble.

fatebound.name: Sapping Strike
fatebound.description: When you use the Sapped Fates Boost, additionally increase damage you deal to a target on your next attack roll made this turn by +1 for each enemy given Fumble.

fatebound.name: God-given Luck
fatebound.description: Increase the Fumble given to each target when using Lucky Break by one dice type.

fatebound.name: Divine Fates
fatebound.description: Increase the Fumble given to each target when using Lucky Break by one dice type.

fatebound.name: Longing Fates
fatebound.description: Increase the range of Lucky Break to 30ft.

fatebound.name: Targeted Foe
fatebound.description: Choose one target. As long as you maintain Focus, add half your Fate (rounded up) to all to-hit and damage rolls made against that target. You may use this once per combat.

fatebound.name: Resilient Foe
fatebound.description: You are resistant to all damage dealt by a targeted foe by your Proficiency.

fatebound.name: Aware Foe
fatebound.description: Gain 1x advantage to any ‘Make Trait Check’ action to reduce a condition given to you by a targeted foe.

fatebound.name: Crushing Blow
fatebound.description: When you critically hit a Targeted Foe, increase the dice type of your divine weapon by one dice type.

fatebound.name: Imbued Fury
fatebound.description: Your attacks target AD (the lowest armor score among MD, TD, PD) when made against a Targeted Foe.

fatebound.name: Tighten Focus
fatebound.description: When you use Targeted Foe, add your Fate to your to-hit and damage against that target instead of half your Fate. Aristeia [0] Aristeia: When you take Aristeia, gain an Action Pool of Glory points equal to your Proficiency Score. You may spend skill points to learn various Aristeia. Whenever you may spend skill points, you may add to the list of Aristeia you know. When you use the ability, you may declare one of your known Aristeia. You get all of Glory points back after a quick rest.

fatebound.name: Hide of Beasts
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point. You are resistant to all damage you take by half your Proficiency (rounded up) for as long as you maintain Focus.

fatebound.name: Touch of Gold
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point to attempt to give Fatigue equal to half your Proficiency (rounded up) to one target within 5ft of you. They make a Fate check against this effect.

fatebound.name: Divine Slam
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point. All creatures within 10ft of you make a Finesse Check against your Check DC or are pushed 5X ft away from you, where X is half your Proficiency (rounded up).

fatebound.name: Blaze of Glory
fatebound.description: Expend 1 Glory point as your armor radiates in light. All enemies within 10ft of you make a Finesse Check against 1D8+Fate elemental damage, taking half as much on a successful check. The damage dice dealt this way increases to 1D10 at level 5, and to 2D6 at level 11. The type of elemental damage is the same as your divine weapon.

fatebound.name: Elemental Rage
fatebound.description: When you use Blaze of Glory, increase the dice type of elemental damage dealt by 1 dice type.

fatebound.name: Hot Iron
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point as a Boost to any melee attack made against a single target. On a successful hit, deal an additional XD6 elemental damage, where X is your Proficiency. The type of elemental damage is the same as your divine weapon.

fatebound.name: Compelling Gaze
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point to attempt to give X levels of Delirium to every enemy within 5ft of you, where X is half your Proficiency (rounded up). They make a Fate Check against this effect.

fatebound.name: Hero’s Response
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point as a reaction. You may take any number of additional reactions before the start of your next turn (to a maximum of your AP). Reduce your AP on your next turn by the number of additional reactions you take.

fatebound.name: Astonishing Shout
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point to let out a bellow of rage. For each ally within 5ft of you (to a max of half your Proficiency rounded up), gain X temporary HP. For each enemy within 5ft of you (to a max of half your Proficiency rounded up), increase damage dealt by X on the next attack you attempt this turn if you successfully hit. X is equal to half your Proficiency (rounded up).

fatebound.name: Glorious Bellow
fatebound.description: Increase the range of Astonishing Shout by 5ft.

fatebound.name: Divine Bellow
fatebound.description: When you use the Astonishing Shout, every enemy in range is pushed 5ft away from you.

fatebound.name: Gods’ Mist
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point. For as long as you maintain focus, you are shrouded in a divine mist. The mist has a radius of 5X (where X is half your Proficiency, rounded up) centered on you. Inside of this area it is Dim. The mists move to you at the start of your turn, and do not affect you or your allies.

fatebound.name: Spirit Blade
fatebound.description: Expend one Glory point. For as long as you maintain Focus, your divine weapon glows with a spiritual energy. It attacks AD (the lowest armor score among MD, TD, PD) instead of other armor types. Additionally, your weapon can strike incorporeal targets.

fatebound.name: Blinding Divinity
fatebound.description: You may expend a Glory point to cause your armor to blaze with divinity. Choose one target. They make a Fate Check against your Check DC or take the Blinded Condition until the start of your next turn. Once you have used this ability on a target (whether they succeed or fail) you may not do so again until a quick rest has passed.

fatebound.name: Glory of Storms
fatebound.description: You may expend a Glory point as a Boost to any action to ignore the effects of all conditions for your turn, including any Exhaustion you have from being Wounded. You may still roll Trait Checks against any conditions. If you have levels of Wrestle Pin from a creature one size larger or smaller than you, you may still move, but at half speed (rounded up). The creature pinning you moves with you or lets go (removing all Pin). If you use Glory of Storms and are pinned by a creature two sizes larger than you or larger, you still may not use actions. The effects of Glory of Storms end at the end of your turn.

fatebound.name: Font of Glory
fatebound.description: The number of Glory points you get per quick rest is equal to twice your Proficiency Score.

hulinari_warrior.name: Boosted Attack
hulinari_warrior.description: You may apply up to two unique Boosts to attacks made with your divine weapon. Boosts taken this way cannot be the same.

hulinari_warrior.name: Boosted Crit
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to an attack made with a divine weapon, you may apply an extra critical effect if you critically hit.

hulinari_warrior.name: Boostbane
hulinari_warrior.description: Expend two Boosts on a melee attack with your divine weapon. If you miss but your to-hit is greater than or equal to 5 below the target’s defense, reduce your weapon’s base damage by two dice types and deal that damage to the target. Do not add modifiers to damage dealt (only deal base damage dice).

hulinari_warrior.name: Boost Stack
hulinari_warrior.description: You may apply up to three unique Boosts to attacks made with your divine weapon. Boosts taken this way cannot be the same.

hulinari_warrior.name: Boosted Range
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to an attack made with a divine weapon, you may make that attack at 5ft or10ft range. If you use this ability with a polearm that already has 10ft range, you may further extend the range of this attack to 15ft.

hulinari_warrior.name: Boosted Damage
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to an attack made with a divine weapon, increase the damage dice dealt by this weapon by one type if you hit.

hulinari_warrior.name: Damaging Weapon
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to an attack made with a divine weapon, increase the damage dice dealt by this weapon by one type if you hit. Treat this as a unique Boost from Boosted Damage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Long Arc
hulinari_warrior.description: Once per turn as a Boost to an attack with a divine weapon, you may expend one additional AP to make that attack against two targets. Only apply the base weapon damage dice to all targets (i.e., do not add Power or other modifiers to damage dealt). You may only use this Boost if two enemies are within range and within 5ft of one another.

hulinari_warrior.name: Solar Arc
hulinari_warrior.description: When using Long Arc, you may choose to make an attack against up to three targets. Only apply the base weapon damage dice to all targets if you hit. You may only use this Boost if three targets are within 5ft of at least one other target and all targets are in range of your divine weapon.

hulinari_warrior.name: Last Chance
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to an attack with a divine weapon, roll an additional 1D20. If that 1D20 would critically hit, you critically hit. You can only roll this D20 if your roll would originally hit, but not crit.

hulinari_warrior.name: Boostbuster
hulinari_warrior.description: You may apply one Boost to attacks of opportunity.

hulinari_warrior.name: Boosted Fury
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to an attack with a divine weapon, you may reduce your to-hit by X to increase damage if you successfully hit by 2X (where X is any number up to your Proficiency). [3] Greater Elemental Weapon: (Prerequisite: Fate 4). Choose the Boon that matches the elemental damage type dealt by your divine weapon: Vampiric WeaponA: (Prerequisite: Rot Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest you attempt to steal the life of a target. Choose one target. They make a Fate Check. If they fail, reduce their HP by XD6 and gain temporary HP equal to half the damage dealt (where X is half your Proficiency, rounded up). Crystaline WeaponF: (Prerequisite: Salt Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest as a Boost to the Kick action, you may make the Kick action against a creature within 60ft of you instead of 5ft, and push them in any direction. Stone WeaponR: (Prerequisite: Earth Elemental Weapon). Once per quick rest as a reaction to an enemy within 30ft of you moving, you may use a reaction to cause them to treat terrain as difficult for that Move action. The Hulinari Warrior T he low rumble of an approaching stampede, the roar of a massive bear crushing against the trees, or the fluttering of a thousand butterfly wings. The Hulinari is the force of a species of animal brought fully to battle, and they reflect that animal in their ferocity as well as their natural inclination for savage combat. The Hulinari is at its best in combat against multiple enemies. Reveling in the odds, Hulinari often see their purpose to take down the human world–and what better way to do that than slashing them to pieces five at a time? Mastery of Feather and HideP: Increase your HP by 1 for every two levels, and increase the size of your HP pools by the same amount. [Level 15] Mostly HumanB: You may change between a human and beast form as a Boost to another action. Form of The Pack You may only take the below abilities if you have the Pack Hulinari Heritage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Headbutt
hulinari_warrior.description: Make a melee attack vs. PD while in Pack Form, dealing 1D8+Finesse damage on a successful hit. Damage dice rolled this way increases to 1D10 at level 5, and 2D6 at level 11.

hulinari_warrior.name: Hornier
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the damage of Headbutt by 1 dice type.

hulinari_warrior.name: Gorier
hulinari_warrior.description: (Prerrequisite: Power 4). Increase the damage of Headbutt by 1 dice type.

hulinari_warrior.name: Skullcharge
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use ‘Headbutt’ and move in a straight line at least 20ft to an enemy prior to attacking, add XD6 to your damage, where X is half your Proficiency (rounded up).

hulinari_warrior.name: Gorehorn
hulinari_warrior.description: When you apply Skullcharge to Headbutt, change the benefit to apply XD6 where X is equal to your Proficiency, rather than half your Proficiency.

hulinari_warrior.name: Skittish
hulinari_warrior.description: When in Pack Form, declare a target. When you do so, gain 1x advantage to all Trait Checks that enemy makes you roll.

hulinari_warrior.name: Skittish Step
hulinari_warrior.description: Whenever you are Skittish to a target and they deal damage against you, reduce that damage by your Proficiency.

hulinari_warrior.name: Defensive Step
hulinari_warrior.description: Whenever you are Skittish to a target and they move within 5ft of you, you may use your reaction to move up to half your movement speed away from them without provoking an attack of opportunity.

hulinari_warrior.name: Confused Dance
hulinari_warrior.description: Whenever you are Skittish to a target, you may use a reaction to give that target 1x disadvantage on a Trait Check.

hulinari_warrior.name: Hindkick
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use the Kick action on an enemy, they gain 1X Disadvantage on the Trait Check against Kick.

hulinari_warrior.name: Powerful Buck
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Kick on an enemy, they are pushed 10ft away instead of 5ft.

hulinari_warrior.name: Bucking Toss
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Kick on an enemy, they are pushed up to 20ft away.

hulinari_warrior.name: Tripping Kick
hulinari_warrior.description: (Preqreuisite: Hindkick, Finesse 3). When you use Kick on an enemy and they fail the trait check against it, you may expend a Boost to knock them Prone.

hulinari_warrior.name: Ribcrack
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Kick on an enemy and they fail the trait check against it, you may expend a Boost to deal XD6 damage to them, where X is your Finesse.

hulinari_warrior.name: Stot
hulinari_warrior.description: As a reaction to an enemy coming within 5ft of you, you may jump 5ft into the air. The enemy gains 1X Disadvantage to their first attack against you on their turn.

hulinari_warrior.name: Retreat
hulinari_warrior.description: As a reaction to your turn ending, you may move up to half your move speed in any direction. You do provoke attacks of opportunity this way.

hulinari_warrior.name: Charge the Line
hulinari_warrior.description: You may use an action when in Pack Form to move your movement speed in a straight line. Any creature along that line (occupying a square you cross through) must make a Finesse Check or be knocked 5ft away from that line. If they succeed at the Finesse Check, Charge the Line ends and you stop 5ft in front of them. When using Charge the Line, you may not end your movement in an occupied square. Charge the Line provokes reaction attacks from creatures not in the line but within melee range. Creatures in the line may make a reaction attack, but automatically fail against Charge the Line if they do so. Additionally, they make their Reaction Attacks at 1X Disadvantage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Hoofstomp
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use the ‘Charge the Line’ ability, deal XD4 damage to any creature that fails their Finesse Check, where X is half your proficiency (rounded up).

hulinari_warrior.name: Flattened Earth
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the damage dealt by Hoofstomp to XD4 damage, where X is your Proficiency.

hulinari_warrior.name: The Stompening
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the damage dealt by Hoofstomp to XD6.

hulinari_warrior.name: Hop Over
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Charge the Line, you may apply a Boost to hop over a single medium-sized (or smaller) creature without interrupting the line. They count as a creature not in the line for the purposes of Charge the Line.

hulinari_warrior.name: Momentum
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use the ‘Charge the Line’ ability, creatures who fail fall Prone.

hulinari_warrior.name: Erratic Charge
hulinari_warrior.description: All creatures who make an attack of opportunity against you when you use Charge the Line do so with 1X Disadvantage. This stacks with other sources of disadvantage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Pack Mule
hulinari_warrior.description: You may carry a teammate on your back when in Pack Form. To initiate, they must use their reaction to climb on your back. Reduce your speed by half. While riding you, your ally has Height Advantage in all physical attacks and has a move speed of zero. They can get off at any time with a action or reaction, ending your Focus. If you or an enemy end your Focus, your ally falls to the ground Prone on a random side of you. If you use Pack Mule and Skittish, your ally gains the benefit of all passive Skittish effects.

hulinari_warrior.name: Carried Sacrifice
hulinari_warrior.description: If you are carrying an ally on your back and they would take damage from an attack, you may use your reaction to instead take that damage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Carrying the Team
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Pack Mule, you may use a reaction to impose 1X advantage on any attack your riding teammate makes or 1X disadvantage on an attack made against them.

hulinari_warrior.name: Head Down
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to a Move action when you are using Pack Mule, adversaries may not use Reaction Attacks on an ally you are carrying.

hulinari_warrior.name: Steed and Rider
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Carrying the Team to give an ally advantage, you may give the attack 2X advantage instead of 1X. If you do this, gain 1 Fatigue.

hulinari_warrior.name: Rapidcarry
hulinari_warrior.description: Your speed is not reduced when using Pack Mule.

hulinari_warrior.name: Need for Speed
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase your base movement speed by 10ft in Pack Form.

hulinari_warrior.name: Forest Hooves
hulinari_warrior.description: Ignore difficult terrain from any cause.

hulinari_warrior.name: Bulk Muscle
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase your base Move speed in Pack form by 10ft.

hulinari_warrior.name: Faster Still
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase your base Move speed in Pack form by 10ft.

hulinari_warrior.name: Ride Like the Wind
hulinari_warrior.description: As long as you maintain Focus in Pack Form, double your movement speed.

hulinari_warrior.name: Get Down
hulinari_warrior.description: Whenever you cause an ally to move by any means other than Pack Mule (e.g., Kick), they gain the effects of Half Cover until the start of their turn. [0] Herd Tactics: When you take this ability, you get an Action Pool of herd points equal to your Proficiency Score that you can only use in Pack Form. You get all herd points back after a quick rest. When you take this ability, you may spend skill points to learn herd tactics. Whenever you may spend skill points, you may add to the list of herd tactics you know:

hulinari_warrior.name: Chaotic Wobble
hulinari_warrior.description: You may expend a Herd Point as a Boost to any action. You do not provoke attacks of opportunity on that action.

hulinari_warrior.name: Hard Turn
hulinari_warrior.description: Expend a Herd Point as a Boost to Charge the Line. You may enact a single turn during Charge the Line, turning up to 90 degrees to either side.

hulinari_warrior.name: Blend in with the Herd
hulinari_warrior.description: Expend a Herd Point as a reaction to an enemy making an attack against you or an ally within 5ft of you. If you do, roll 1DX, where X is the number of allies within 5ft of you, including yourself, and each outcome on the 1DX roll corresponds to an ally. The enemy’s attack instead targets the target rolled on the 1DX die. If the target is out of range of the enemy’s attack, that attack misses.

hulinari_warrior.name: Protective Instinct
hulinari_warrior.description: Expend a Herd point and choose a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency within 15ft of you. Each creature chosen is given the effects of half cover until the start of your next turn. You may not use this on an ally on your back through Pack Mule.

hulinari_warrior.name: Grab and Go
hulinari_warrior.description: You may expend a Herd Point as a Boost to a Move action. As part of your movement, move through a square occupied by a willing ally, and then immediately half your move speed for the remainder of the Move action. Move your ally with you as you move, placing them in any unoccupied square within 5ft of the end of your Movement. That ally cannot provoke an attack of opportunity when you move them (though you do).

hulinari_warrior.name: Hoofslam
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to any action that imposes a trait check on an enemy that will move them if they fail (e.g., Kick, Charge the Line), you may expend one Herd Point per target that rolls a Trait Check against being moved. Each target you selects makes this Trait Check at 1X Disadvantage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Herd Management
hulinari_warrior.description: The number of herd points you get per quick rest is equal to twice your Proficiency Score. Form of the Brute You may only take the below abilities if you have the Brute Hulinari Heritage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Body Slam
hulinari_warrior.description: Choose one target within 5ft of you. They make a Finesse Check against your Check DC or are knocked Prone.

hulinari_warrior.name: Shockwave
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to Body Slam, you may expend additional AP up to half your Proficiency (rounded up). For each additional AP expensed on the Body Slam action, attempt to knock an additional target Prone.

hulinari_warrior.name: Thunderwave
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the range of Body Slam to 10ft.

hulinari_warrior.name: Bite
hulinari_warrior.description: When you are in Brute Form, you may make an unarmed melee attack with . Your Bite deals 1D10+Power damage on a successful hit.The damage dice dealt this way increases to 2D6 at level 5 and 2D8 at level 11.

hulinari_warrior.name: Indomitable Beast
hulinari_warrior.description: Every time you kill a creature with a Bite attack, gain 1D10 temporary HP. Increase the dice rolled this way to 2D6 at level 5, and 2D8 at level 11.

hulinari_warrior.name: Necrotic Bite
hulinari_warrior.description: Your bite attack does necrotic damage of XD6 in addition to your base physical damage, where X is half your Proficiency Score (rounded up).

hulinari_warrior.name: Drag the Prey
hulinari_warrior.description: Once per turn, you may attempt to drag a prone target with you as you move up to half speed (rounded up). They make a Finesse Check against the effect.

hulinari_warrior.name: Cleaving Claw
hulinari_warrior.description: Your claws rend armor. When you critically hit with an unarmed melee attack and choose to rend, rend 2 instead of 1 PD.

hulinari_warrior.name: Surrounded Brute
hulinari_warrior.description: The Surrounded Condition does not reduce your PD.

hulinari_warrior.name: Full Monty
hulinari_warrior.description: If you are Surrounded and have enemies on at least 3 sides, treat enemies as Surprised for your first attack each turn.

hulinari_warrior.name: Enduring Animal
hulinari_warrior.description: Roll all Trait Checks against Fatigue using the ‘Make Trait Check’ action at 1X advantage.

hulinari_warrior.name: We Don’t Hibernate
hulinari_warrior.description: You are immune to the Fatigue condition from any source.

hulinari_warrior.name: Sweeping Claws
hulinari_warrior.description: , , , When in Brute Form, you may make an unarmed melee attack using your claws against every creature within 5ft of you. Reduce damage dealt this way by one dice type.

hulinari_warrior.name: Strength of Ten Men
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Sweeping Claws, your attack only deals damage to enemies, and does not harm allies.

hulinari_warrior.name: Cornered Courage
hulinari_warrior.description: When you are Surrounded, add half your Courage (rounded up) to damage dealt through Sweeping Claws.

hulinari_warrior.name: Double Claw
hulinari_warrior.prerequisite: Sweeping Claws, Larger than Life, Power 5
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Sweeping Claws, your attack is made against every creature within 10’ of you.

hulinari_warrior.name: Reaching Claw
hulinari_warrior.description: Make a melee attack against an enemy 15’ from you in Brute Form. If successful, move them to within 10’ of you. Treat them as prone for your next attack made this turn.

hulinari_warrior.name: Tear Apart
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to any attack made against a single target, if you kill that target, you rip them apart. All enemies within 5ft of you gain the Surprised Condition.

hulinari_warrior.name: Spray of Gore
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Tear Apart, deal 1D6 damage to any creature you give the Surprised Condition to (apply damage before giving the target Surprised). Increase damage dice dealt this way to 1D8 at level 5, and 1D10 at level 11.

hulinari_warrior.name: Tearing Fright
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Tear Apart, choose one target within 5ft of you. In addition to Surprise, attempt to give them Panic equal to half your Proficiency (rounded up).

hulinari_warrior.name: Hidebite
hulinari_warrior.description: When you make an attack of opportunity against a target, increase the damage dice of your attack by one dice type.

hulinari_warrior.name: Grand Hidebite
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the dice type of attacks of opportunity you make by one additional type.

hulinari_warrior.name: Toughhide
hulinari_warrior.description: When you are surrounded and in Brute Form, gain 1 damage resistance to all physical attacks made against you.

hulinari_warrior.name: Brute Adrenaline
hulinari_warrior.description: You may shrug off hits that would otherwise hurt when in Brute Form. As long as you maintain Focus, you are resistant to all physical attacks made against you by half your Courage score (rounded up). This stacks with Toughhide.

hulinari_warrior.name: Larger Than Life
hulinari_warrior.description: Your Brute Form is a Large creature rather than Medium.

hulinari_warrior.name: Trapped Animal
hulinari_warrior.description: When you are Pinned, you may still use the Move action. Treat all movement distance as affected by Difficult Terrain. If there is a creature pinning you, they may move with you or release you from Pin.

hulinari_warrior.name: Displace
hulinari_warrior.description: You may use the Displace Boost on a Move action to attempt to end that move action on a space occupied by enemies. Any enemies in a space you attempt to occupy must make a Power Check against your Check DC or are pushed 5ft away into an empty square. Enemies get 1x advantage for each ally also making this Trait Check, but also receive disadvantage from your size if relevant. If any enemies pass their Power Check, you must end your move action in the nearest square you would have moved through prior to moving onto their space.

hulinari_warrior.name: Greater Displace
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use Displace, enemies do not make Trait Checks against the effect and are simply moved. You cannot move into a space if the creatures in that space cannot move out of your way.

hulinari_warrior.name: Mighty Roar
hulinari_warrior.description: You may roar in the face of a prone target within 5ft when in Brute Form. They make a Courage Check against your Check DC, and take X levels of Fatigue if they fail (where X is half your Proficiency, rounded up).

hulinari_warrior.name: Meatclub
hulinari_warrior.description: When you are in Brute Form, you may pick up an enemy and throw them. That enemy must be at least one size smaller than you. You attempt to throw them a distance up to 5Xft, where X is your Proficiency. The target you throw must make a Finesse check against being knocked prone. If you throw a target with Meatclub into another target, both targets must make a Finesse Check against being knocked Prone.

hulinari_warrior.name: Thrown Stick
hulinari_warrior.description: When you throw a target with Meatclub, they take 1D8 damage for every 10ft they are thrown. If they are thrown into another target and both targets fail their Finesse Check against being knocked Prone, deal this damage to both targets.

hulinari_warrior.name: Steeltip
hulinari_warrior.description: Whenever a creature deals damage to you through a melee attack vs. PD, deal damage back to them equal to half your Proficiency (rounded up). [0] Savage Blows: When you take this ability, you get an Action Pool of savage points equal to your Proficiency Score that you can only use in Brute Form. You get all savage points back after a quick rest. When you take this ability, you may spend skill points to learn savage blows. Whenever you may spend skill points, you may add to the list of savage blows you know:

hulinari_warrior.name: A Deeper Rend
hulinari_warrior.description: Expend one savage point and choose a limb (choose or one ). For as long as you maintain focus, increase the damage dice dealt by all attacks made with that limb by one type.

hulinari_warrior.name: Confidence
hulinari_warrior.description: When you make trait checks against mental conditions given to you by an adversary, you may expend one Savage Point to gain 1X advantage on that roll.

hulinari_warrior.name: Enormity
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to Body Slam, expense one Savage Point for each creature Body Slam would affect. All targets who roll a Power Check against being knocked prone do so at 1X disadvantage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Barreling Stature
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Boost to an action made against a single target, you may expense one Savage Point. Treat that target as prone for that action.

hulinari_warrior.name: Beastly Presence
hulinari_warrior.description: Expense X Savage Points where X is any number up to half your Proficiency (rounded up). Attempt to give one target within 5ft of you that many levels of Panic or Taunt. You may only use this ability once per quick rest on a single target.

hulinari_warrior.name: Ironhide
hulinari_warrior.description: Expense one Savage Point. As long as you maintain Focus, ignore the effects of Nausea, Frenzy, Taunt, or Panic (choose one when you initiate Focus).

hulinari_warrior.name: Unrestrained Savagery
hulinari_warrior.description: The number of Savage Points you get per quick rest is equal to twice your Proficiency Score. Form of the Swarm You may only take the below abilities if you have the Swarm Hulinari Heritage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Hovering Foe
hulinari_warrior.description: When in Swarm Form, select a single target within 5ft of you.They may make a Finesse Check against your Check DC. If they fail, reduce your Move speed to 0 and move onto that target’s square for as long as you maintain Focus. When they move, you move with them. For as long as you maintain Focus on Hovering Foe and share a square with that target, they are treated as surrounded provided they are your enemy. This has no default effect on allies. Your Focus ends if you move away from them, or if they successfully use a Make Trait Check action to make a Finesse Check against your Check DC.

hulinari_warrior.name: Swarm Confusion
hulinari_warrior.description: As an action while you are focusing on Hovering Foe, that target gets 1X Disadvantage on all Trait Checks made against you until the start of your next turn.

hulinari_warrior.name: Disarming Bites
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use ‘Hovering Foe’ on a target, you may use a reaction to give that target 1x Disadvantage or 1x Advantage on any Trait check.

hulinari_warrior.name: Armor Nics
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use ‘Hovering Foe’ on a target, you may use a reaction to reduce or increase their Mental and Physical Defense by your Finesse score against a single attack. You may declare this ability after the attack roll is made.

hulinari_warrior.name: Maneuver Cloud
hulinari_warrior.description: When you use ‘Hovering Foe’, you may use an action to move yourself and the target of ‘Hovering Foe’ up to 10ft in any direction. They may make a Finesse Check against the effect.

hulinari_warrior.name: Birdshield
hulinari_warrior.description: For as long as you maintain Focus on Bird Shield, reduce all damage the target of Hovering Foe takes by X, where X is equal to your Proficiency. This ability ends if you drop Focus on Hovering Foe.

hulinari_warrior.name: Birdbite
hulinari_warrior.description: For as long as you maintain Focus on Birdbite, the target of your Hovering Foe effect takes XD10 damage at the start of their turn, where X is equal to half your Proficiency (rounded up). There is no Trait Check against this effect. If an enemy successfully uses Make Trait Check against Hovering Foe while you also have Focus on Birdbite, you drop Focus on Birdbite instead.

hulinari_warrior.name: Sharpbeak
hulinari_warrior.description: When you are Focusing on Birdbite, you may make a melee attack against the target’s PD. If you succeed, do not deal damage. Instead, increase the damage of Birdbite by two dice types at the start of their next turn.

hulinari_warrior.name: Speedy Cloud
hulinari_warrior.description: (Preqreuisite: Hovering Foe, Finesse 3). When you use Hovering Foe on a target, you may use a reaction in response to them taking the Move action. If you do, you may reduce or increase their Move speed by X, where X is 5 times your Finesse Score. They may make a Finesse Check against this effect.

hulinari_warrior.name: Picking at Armor
hulinari_warrior.description: For as long as you maintain Focus on Picking at Armor, the target of Hovering Foe is rended 1 at the start of each of their turns. If an enemy successfully uses Make Trait Check against Hovering Foe while you also have Focus on Picking at Armor, you drop Focus on Picking at Armor instead.

hulinari_warrior.name: Pick Harder
hulinari_warrior.description: When you are Focusing on Picking at Armor, you may make a single attack against that target’s MD. If you successfully hit, rend their armor by 1.

hulinari_warrior.name: Lend a Wing
hulinari_warrior.description: As a Reaction when you are maintaining Focus on Hovering Foe and the target of Hovering Foe is attacked, you may take all the damage instead.

hulinari_warrior.name: Blackcloud
hulinari_warrior.description: All enemies within 15ft of you get 1X Disadvantage on any mental Trait Check as long as you maintain Focus.

hulinari_warrior.name: Drowning Cloud
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the radius of Blackcloud to 20ft.

hulinari_warrior.name: Cry of Delirium
hulinari_warrior.description: Attempt to give all enemies within the radius of Blackcloud 1 level of Delirium (Wiles Check negates).

hulinari_warrior.name: Deafening Caw
hulinari_warrior.description: When in Swarm Form, you may use an action to attempt to give all enemies within 30ft of you 1D4 fumble. Increase this Fumble to 1D6 at level 5, and 1D8 at level 11. They make Fate Checks against this effect.

hulinari_warrior.name: Clawing Talons
hulinari_warrior.description: Choose one target within 5ft of you. Make a melee attack against MD. If you hit, deal 2D6+Wiles Piercing Damage.

hulinari_warrior.name: Focused Claw
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the damage dice of Clawing Talons by 1 dice type for each Focus action you have maintained or initiated successfully on this turn.

hulinari_warrior.name: Hyperfocused
hulinari_warrior.description: Increase the damage dice of Clawing Talons by 1 additional dice type for each Focus action you have maintained or initiated successfully on this turn.
